scientific_summary: A pure n-way interaction with every proper subvector iid N(0,1) exactly rescales one-sample Student tails above the sharp threshold n-1; with four observations the conventional two-sided 5% t-test can have exact size from 0% to 10% while every triple is iid N(0,1).
limitations: No global extremal claim over all limited-independence Gaussian-marginal laws; the pure sign interaction has parity-specific two-sided behavior; equivalent older formulations under different dependence terminology remain a residual originality risk.
